bullets.title: AVGO soft AI chip guidance drags Nasdaq futures down 1.5%
bullets.body: Broadcom issued soft AI chip guidance post-earnings, pushing NDX futures to session lows of -1.5% and SPX -0.4% to -0.6% pre-market. Tech valuations described as 'stretched' ahead of the $75B SpaceX IPO, compounding the negative sentiment.

bullets.title: AVGO shares hit session low, down 15%
bullets.body: Broadcom shares extended their decline to a session low of -15% as the market digested the soft AI chip guidance. No specific forward commentary provided beyond the price action signal.

bullets.title: HSBC's Max Kettner: slowing AI spend and chip supply glut are the bear case
bullets.body: HSBC strategist Max Kettner says his bearish trigger would be 'any signs of stretched sentiment and positioning,' slowing AI spending, or increased chip supply causing a glut. He is notably unconcerned by earnings misses, geopolitical risks, or higher Treasury yields.

bullets.title: Tech layoffs hit highest since Aug 2024; AI cited as primary driver
bullets.body: The tech sector announced 38,242 job cuts last month, the most since August 2024, with AI automation cited as the leading reason. Total U.S. job cuts in May reached 97,006, the highest for that month since 2020, and May Challenger Gray data showed cut announcements up 3.4% YoY reversing a prior -20.9% decline.

bullets.title: Strong macro data vs. weak risk sentiment: ISM services new orders surge, factory orders soar
bullets.body: ISM Services new orders jumped to 57.3 in May (vs. 53.5 prior, above 12-month avg of 54.7) and April factory orders rose +4.8% m/m—the largest gain since May 2025—driven by a 22% surge in transportation equipment. ADP also showed broad-based private payroll gains across all firm sizes in May, yet futures remain under pressure.

bullets.title: Oil drops 3%+ on US-Iran ceasefire signals; Hormuz tanker bottleneck remains
bullets.body: Brent and WTI crude futures fell over 3% as the White House signaled it will maintain a ceasefire with Iran unless American troops are killed, and Trump claimed the US is 'in the middle of final negotiations to end the Iran war.' However, Iran's foreign minister said 'no tangible progress' has been achieved, and 80 of 109 oil tankers remain trapped in the Persian Gulf since the conflict began.

bullets.title: Bitcoin hits 4-month low; crypto stocks under pressure; $1.8B in liquidations
bullets.body: Bitcoin fell to $61,311 before partially rebounding to $62,580, down ~27% YTD, driven by ETF outflows, geopolitical tensions, and Strategy Bitcoin sales. Over $1.8B in levered crypto positions were liquidated, pressuring crypto-related equities.

bullets.title: China margin debt exceeds 2015 bubble peak — Goldman data
bullets.body: China's margin trading balance has now surpassed the peak of the 2015 equity bubble, per Goldman Sachs data, signaling elevated leverage risk in Chinese equities.

bullets.title: INTC: Lip Bu era revealed prior data-sharing failure with SME vendors hurt yields
bullets.body: Intel's new leadership under Lip Bu uncovered that the prior management had not shared sufficient data with SME vendors to optimize manufacturing yields—a significant operational revelation. The shift to opening data to vendors is underway, representing a meaningful process improvement from prior leadership failures.

bullets.title: INTC: Nova Lake next-gen LGA 1954 socket spotted online
bullets.body: Intel's upcoming Nova Lake processor platform featuring a new LGA 1954 socket has made its first public online appearance, signaling continued roadmap execution for next-gen client CPUs.

bullets.title: AMZN invests €10B+ in European fulfillment, adds 25K jobs; holds OUST lidar warrant
bullets.body: Amazon announced over €10B in European fulfillment center investment with faster delivery expansion and 25,000 new jobs. Separately, Amazon holds a warrant in Ouster (OUST) contingent on continued lidar purchases; OUST was down 4% pre-market.

bullets.title: NVDA venture arm was pre-IPO investor in AI biotech GENB
bullets.body: Nvidia's venture arm backed Generate Biomedicines (GENB) pre-IPO; the company raised ~$400M in a February 2026 Nasdaq IPO. GENB uses generative AI for protein design with a lead Phase 3 asset (anti-TSLP mAb GB-0895) for severe asthma/COPD, representing Nvidia's positioning in generative AI for biology.

bullets.title: HOOD benefits as pattern day trader restrictions ease
bullets.body: Robinhood and Webull are lifting pattern day trader restrictions, removing friction for retail traders executing rapid-fire stock and options trades—a direct structural positive for Robinhood's trading volumes and engagement metrics.

bullets.title: NOK, LITE, COHR, CIEN flagged for must-read analysis
bullets.body: A fintwit account flagged NOK, LITE, COHR, and CIEN as names worth watching with a linked analysis piece, suggesting potential sector-level catalyst or shared thematic read-through for optical/telecom networking names.

bullets.title: MTSI took IQE stake; CHIPS Act funding complicates M&A for compound semi names
bullets.body: CHIPS Act funding restrictions make it difficult for major companies to acquire funded firms outright; MTSI's stake in IQE is cited as an alternative partnership model. GFS and JBL mentioned as potential future partners for SIVE under the same dynamic.

bullets.title: AI productivity gap: adoption at 30% but no macro-level output gain yet
bullets.body: Despite markets pricing AI as revolutionary, productivity data across developed economies show no measurable change in trend over four years of adoption. Tech adoption is roughly 30% across developed economies with AI cited as the leading reason for tech layoffs but not yet showing up in aggregate output statistics.

bullets.title: North American M&A rebounds to $315B in May from $286B in April
bullets.body: North American M&A announcement volumes rose to $315B in May from $286B in April, per themarketear citing market data, suggesting deal activity is reaccelerating despite macro uncertainty.

bullets.title: Constellation's Three Mile Island nuclear restart gets FERC waiver boost
bullets.body: Constellation Energy's Three Mile Island nuclear restart received a FERC waiver, a meaningful regulatory milestone for the project's timeline and power delivery commitments.

bullets.title: VOO AUM: 56% driven by new inflows, not price appreciation
bullets.body: Over 56% of VOO's total AUM growth has come from new cash inflows rather than market appreciation, highlighting the sustained structural demand for passive S&P 500 exposure that underpins index-level valuations.

bullets.title: NOW: fintwit trader accumulating on support holds
bullets.body: One active fintwit trader disclosed an existing position in ServiceNow (NOW) and stated willingness to add more if price demonstrates support-level holds, signaling conviction at current levels.
